The Drop Block removes clutter from your counters and allows you to see your entire selection of knives. With a traditional knife block, you are constantly lifting one knife after another to see if it is the one you want. With The Drop Block this is eliminated because all knives are right in front of you when lowered. When The Drop Block is raised, they are out of site and safely tucked away.  Great for small kitchens and apartments!!
